changes_made.explanation: Removed models that are mentioned but not evaluated NLG models (QWen-2 Audio, QWen-2.5 are for captioning; CLAP-T Encoder, ImageBind are for encoding/reward). Only kept Siren (proposed model) and AudioGen (baseline). Normalized VG-GSound to VGGSound.

Consolidated metric variants to base forms with standardized capitalization (e.g., 'Fréchet Audio Distance' instead of 'FAD', 'Kullback-Leibler Divergence' instead of 'KL divergence'). Removed duplicates.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted. Removed placeholder 'None' entries.

guideline: Raters were presented with three audio clips (one from each system) and asked to rank them on Fidelity Quality (audio realism and sound clarity) and Instruction Following (accuracy reflecting the prompt).

changes_made.explanation: Kept criteria as explicitly mentioned. Guideline condensed from repeated descriptions.

overall_notes: Paper focuses on Text-to-Audio Generation using transformer-based language models with residual vector quantization. Automatic metrics and human evaluation are used. Extraction was generally accurate but included non-evaluated models; these were removed for clarity.
